theme_scoping_strategy.concept: Hybrid Theme Scoping via CSS Variables Wrapper
theme_scoping_strategy.implementation: Do not alter the global `body` or `:root` dark theme selectors. Instead, append a `.dashboard-light` class to `/app/frontend/src/index.css` containing light-theme HSL variable overrides (Shadcn standard variables). Wrap the root layout of the admin/dashboard routes in a `<div className="dashboard-light min-h-screen bg-background text-foreground">`.
theme_scoping_strategy.left_nav_exception: The LeftNav component should hardcode dark classes (e.g., `bg-[#0A0A0A] text-slate-400`) to maintain brand continuity with the rest of the dark app.

component_architecture.description: Global search input (pill-shaped), quick create (+) button, notification bell with badge, and user avatar.

component_architecture.description: Card with title, optional total number, Recharts PieChart (left), and custom legend list (right).

component_architecture.name: DashboardTabs

component_architecture.name: ViewToggle

component_architecture.name: SortableTable

component_architecture.name: StatusPill

structure: Left Sidebar (80px wide): Dark #0A0A0A, vertical stack of Lucide icons. 2nd icon has a square white/teal bg denoting 'active'.
Top Bar (64px high): White bg. Left: 'Admin Dashboard' title. Middle: Search bar (rounded-full, bg-slate-100). Right: Add button, Bell (red dot), Avatar.
- Header Row: 'Overview' / 'Table' Tabs on left. '+ Create Event' solid teal button on right.
- KPI Row (4 cards): White bg, rounded-xl, light border. Each has a 80px donut chart on the left and a dense vertical list of legend items on the right (e.g., '• Live - 42').
- Table Header Controls: Search input, Filter, Group By, Import buttons on right. Table/Board segment toggle on left.
- Table: White bg, rounded-xl. Checkboxes on left. Avatar circles overlapping in 'Assigned To'. Status Pills in 'Stage' column.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Do not use `.tsx` files; strictly create React components in `.js` and standard Tailwind CSS.
2. Inject the `.dashboard-light` CSS variables into `src/index.css` to safely scope the light theme. Ensure the `DashboardShell` wrapper includes this class.

3. Build the `KpiDonutCard` using `recharts`. Use `<PieChart>`, `<Pie>`, and `<Cell>` mapped over the provided Kreeda brand colors. Do not use default recharts tooltips/legends; build a custom DOM legend beside the chart to match the reference.
4. Construct the `SortableTable` using Shadcn `Table` components, adding custom padding and border-b. Ensure avatars in the table are tiny (w-6 h-6).
5. Do NOT alter any backend API calls or data fetching logic. Mock the transformation of existing API data to the sports context (e.g., map pipeline data to bookings/events).
6. Use `sonner` for the bottom-right toast notification for actions like 'Booking updated'.
7. Add `data-testid` attributes to all interactive elements as defined in the component architecture.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx (or .js).
